items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Governor Claiborne was, he was governing Russia.

ctx.x: Either Ivorville or Bienville or somebody. Yeah, it was one of those. I think one of the guys that discovered or founded New Orleans.
Governor Claiborne was, he was governing Russia. There were three brothers on the streets with AMAP, the Claiborne, Bienville, and Ivorville.
Well, I think Claiborne was later. They gave us the first American governor when he came to.
